input.command:
DT=2026-11-16
# provenance today
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime
paths=[
"/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
"/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
]
for p in paths:
  print("====", p, "====")
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    print("MISSING"); continue
  n=0
  with open(p,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      # try find date fields
      blob=json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)
      if "2026-11-16" not in blob and "2026/11/16" not in blob:
        # also check ts
        ts=o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("received_at") or ""
        if "2026-11-16" not in str(ts) and "11-16" not in str(ts):
          continue
      n+=1
      src=o.get("source") or o.get("from") or o.get("kind") or ""
      bid=o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to_bus_id") or ""
      text=(o.get("text") or o.get("summary") or o.get("prompt") or o.get("body") or "")[:200]
      print(f"- src={src} bus={bid} :: {text.replace(chr(10),' ')[:180]}")
  print(f"count={n}")
PY
